mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sagas (saga_id, saga_type, status, data, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sagaId}, #{sagaType}, #{status}, #{data}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT saga_id, saga_type, status, data, created_at, updated_at FROM sagas WHERE saga_type = #{sagaType} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
